parent_evidence_problems: Lilly p535 allows other planets dignified in a primary occupant's place to participate; current S1_one is a single geometric PRIMARY, not the sole comprehensive manners ruler.

The strongest planet among several p535/S2 primary participants requires source-complete fortitude, including possible reception, combustion, speed, fixed stars, other aspects/nodes; previous 72-policy partial leaders cannot be promoted to a final historical choice.
S4 p536 'forcibly' remains source-unresolved; counted possibility cannot be declared actual manners ruler and does not necessarily preclude later positive-place dignity fallback.
S5 source positive place scores omit reception and negative essential conditions and overall nativity/manners strength; print term and aggregation alternatives are not uniquely resolved.
SX and SY are original source underdetermination and must not be silently forced into later source stages.
All results are 15-min source-neutral samples at one predeclared place, not all births or human observations.
True Ptolemy III.13 phase/aspect/contrary testimony and independent private participant behavioral validation remain OPEN.
